name: Kisaragi Ayano
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c69139]Ryuuji's[/url] younger twin sister. She thinks her brother is a pervert and often makes fun of him and yells. She hates the 'Pregnancy Plan' the villagers propose and complains that she shouldn't be expected to take part because she's Ryuuji's true sister.
